'''Lancer Squadron''' was a military unit in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Made up of [[Republic trooper]]s clad in white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with orange markings, they were deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="OTT" />
